findings.summary: Grey, small text on a dark background is very hard to read even when enlarged, especially the lines under the big numbers and the bank notes.
Many red minus amounts in the fund list make it look as if the money is being lost.
English fund names and codes (iShares, Vanguard, UCITS ETF, IE00...) have no Hebrew explanation.
The 7% return is filled in already, with nothing clearly saying it is only an assumption.
Every fund carries too many coloured labels, and the reader cannot tell the colours apart or what they mean.
The two-column screens are busy, with numbers on both sides at once.
The pale lines under 86,492 ('בכסף של היום' and the dollar note) are confusing.
Pesagot is less familiar than the big banks, and the page does not say why it can be trusted.
